Lena (Partner Ops): Quick sync after today's HW partner call. They can provide a price sheet but we need to standardize fields before import into the pricing engine.

Marco (Pricing): What exact columns? Keep it minimal but finance needs enough to run sensitivity.

Lena (Partner Ops): Proposal: `partner_id,sku,hw_family,gpu_count,region,billing_unit,on_demand_rate,reserved_rate_1yr,reserved_rate_3yr,reserved_min_commit_hours,spot_rate,spot_mean_interruption_pct,spot_history_sample_size,max_burst_nodes,guaranteed_capacity_nodes,availability_window_start,availability_window_end,marketplace_commission_pct,invoice_settlement_terms,early_termination_fee_usd,price_escalation_ann_pct`.

Tao (Supply): Add `monthly_supply_forecast_12mo` (CSV can include 12 columns for months) and `lead_time_days` and `production_capacity_util_pct`.

Marco (Pricing): We'll interpret `spot_mean_interruption_pct` as an annualized hazard. Also need `fallback_sku` and `migration_cost_per_job_usd` to compute expected spot tail cost. Formula we'll use in modeling: `E(cost) = spot_rate + interruption_hazard * (migration_cost + fallback_rate * expected_remaining_hours)`.

Priya (Marketing): If partners want a joint announcement, capture `embargo_date`, `approved_logos`, `announcement_contacts`, `co_marketing_budget_usd` and any exclusivity windows.

Lena (Partner Ops): Forgot billing: add `supports_marketplace_billing` (yes/no) and `supports_direct_invoicing` (yes/no) and `marketplace_settlement_delay_days`.

marketplace-bot: Template available: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/templates/partner-price-schema.csv

Tao (Supply): Partners flagged that preemption behavior varies by region; include `preemption_granularity` (instance/pod), `preemption_grace_seconds`, and `historical_preemption_rate_pct_by_month` if possible.

Marco (Pricing): Also request any `volume_discount_breakpoints` and `discount_pct_at_breakpoint` pairs. We'll model committed discounts vs on-demand.

Priya (Marketing): Add `partner_approved_quote_template` (Y/N) and `joint_sales_playbook_link`. We need that for go-to-market.

Lena (Partner Ops): I'll send the CSV schema and a short modeling note. Ask them to include an example row per SKU and a separate sheet with monthly supply forecast and any blackout windows (e.g., manufacturing maintenance).

Marco (Pricing): Also ask for contractual terms: `min_contract_term_months`, `notice_period_days`, `renewal_auto_renew` (Y/N). These affect committed pricing and churn modeling.

Tao (Supply): If they can't provide interruption stats, request raw spot price history (1hr granularity) for last 6 months and we'll estimate hazard.

Lena (Partner Ops): Action: I'll send schema by EOD. If we get data this week, Marco/Tao can produce a baseline Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta. Priya: flag any PR constraints once we get `embargo_date`.

marketplace-bot: Logged: "partner_pricing_schema_sent" by Lena at 1751300200

Marco (Pricing): One final ask: `warranty_and_support_fee_pct` and `rma_lead_time_days` if hardware is being reserved for Dedicated customers.

Lena (Partner Ops): Nice catch. Adding those. Sending now.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks team. I'll prep a short Go/No-Go checklist for announcements once data and legal signoff are in place. :shipit:
